note.description: One line on what this change is for. Shown to the person waiting.

ops.description: Applied in order. Either they all pass validation or none are kept. Each upsert adds one thing or replaces the one that already has its key, stated in full — anything omitted is cleared — and touches nothing else. Send several in one call.

oneOf.title: upsert_screen
oneOf.description: One screen people navigate to. A screen answers ONE QUESTION somebody has — 'what needs my attention', 'how are we doing', 'everything we know about this customer' — and it is made of sections, each of which may draw on a DIFFERENT entity. Every app needs at least one screen. An entity that declares an owner cannot be a screen's subject: its rows render inside the owner's detail. Name the OWNER instead. Do not describe layout — say what belongs on the screen and in what order of importance, and the arrangement is worked out for you.

label.description: What this screen is called in navigation.

subject.description: The entity this screen is ABOUT, if there is one. Context only — a screen with a subject can still show sections over other entities, and a screen that spans several kinds of record has no subject at all.

tabs.description: Perspectives on the same records that share this screen. Sections above stay visible while these swap. Separate jobs are separate screens.

oneOf.title: upsert_screen_tab
oneOf.description: Change ONE tab, leaving the screen's other tabs and shared sections alone. Sending the whole screen instead would restate tabs somebody already approved.

oneOf.title: remove_screen_tab
oneOf.description: Drop one tab from a screen.

key.description: Stable name for this section, unique on its screen. Keep it when the label changes — what people have saved about this list is filed under it.

kind.description: list: records to work through. metric: one number. chart: a breakdown. text: a note. split: two of those side by side, when they are read together.

of.description: The entity this section draws on. Sections on one screen may differ.

label.description: The heading. For a list, also its name in navigation.

view.description: For kind=list: how the records are shown.

dateField.description: For view=calendar: the date field that places a record on the calendar. Required — an entity often has several dates and the wrong one gives a calendar that looks right and answers a different question.

filter.description: Which records this section is about. Use {{actor.id}} for the signed-in person — that is what makes 'my open tickets' different from 'all tickets', and showing somebody everything when they wanted their own is the most common way a screen is useless.

sort.description: For kind=list. Put the most urgent row first.

columns.description: For kind=list as a table or a board: which fields to show. Leave out what the filter already implies — a list of MY tickets does not need an assignee column. A calendar shows a record's own name and takes none.

groupBy.description: For view=board: the field the columns are. For kind=chart: what the breakdown splits by.

value.description: For kind=metric and kind=chart: what is counted or totalled.

visual.description: For kind=chart. Leave it out unless the shape matters: a breakdown over TIME is a line or an area, and nothing about the numbers says so.

sections.description: For kind=split: the two sections that sit side by side. Both must be content — a split inside a split is a grid, which this is not.

ratio.description: For kind=split: relative widths, e.g. [2,1]. Omit for equal, which is usually right.

key.description: Stable name. Keep it when the label changes.
